svg.title: master-wiring.svg
svg.text: Every component appears once. Follow each continuous wire from its source to its destination.
● Joined wires Crossings without a dot are not connected.
Head power branches before body pixel 0.
Speaker outputs stay separate from ground.
WAGO ports within each block are internally joined. W1/5 and W4/5 stay empty.
Positions and connector contact order are schematic. Use the step close-ups for assembly.
svg.desc: One connected wiring diagram. All external wires run continuously between component terminals; no named off-sheet continuations. Pi numbers are physical header pins. HEAD and H3 are three-contact detachable lighting connectors. Three servos connect directly to WAGO power and ground and shifter signal terminals.
